reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: function has non-test callers (actions.ts:60, kiosk/page.tsx:34) and is GRANT EXECUTE'd to anon role, making it a live public endpoint. Gate 2: attack entry point is the unauthenticated anon role (no trust_assumptions defined; anon internet callers are untrusted). Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is in scope and race condition in record_attendance_by_card is explicitly listed in key_security_concerns. An attacker can trigger this via the anon Supabase RPC endpoint by sending two concurrent calls for the same card_id (e.g., `supabase.schema('attendance').rpc('record_attendance_by_card', { p_card_id: '<target>' })`), causing both requests to read the same v_last_type before either commits and both inserting identical attendance records, corrupting the target user's check-in/check-out toggle state.
